verdict.rationale: Glama publishes a machine-discoverable OpenAPI 3.0.3 REST API with /v1 endpoints for servers, connectors, instances and usage. It authenticates with bearer keys and has cURL/Python samples, so automation can drive it without a UI, and the pricing page claims schedule- or webhook-driven workflows. There is no documented CLI, CI integration guide or headless runner, the Gateway has no REST spec, and one user found API-triggered rebuilds blocked by an undocumented credit requirement. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI integration (e.g. GitHub Actions) docs, headless coverage of Gateway and hosting operations, and independent corroboration of reliable CI-driven automation.
